messages:
liz_sales: Quick sync — ACME wants a Private deployment POC inside their VPC (on‑prem via Direct Connect into TGW). They want PrivateLink or peering? Timeline: start next Tue. Who can own provisioning + POC API keys?

sam_solutions: I can own the provisioning and endpoint setup. Need their AWS account IDs + the exact CIDR ranges for the subnets they want ENIs in. For a short POC I recommend Interface VPC Endpoint (PrivateLink) to avoid opening inbound ports.

raj_infra: FYI for on‑prem return traffic: if their edge does DNAT/hairpin, we need static SNAT or ensure reply path goes via TGW. Otherwise you'll see connection resets. Also we must pick subnet CIDRs with available IPs for the ENIs (VPCECHO: interface endpoints create ENIs in each subnet).

liz_sales: Customer asked whether we can do Hosted API keys bound to the PrivateLink ENI or if they need a Dedicated pool. They want perf numbers later but prefer quick start.

aisha_se: For POC: easiest is a short‑lived hosted API key scoped to the project. If they insist on Dedicated, that adds provisioning time. Also confirm any MTLS requirement — do they want client certs?

liz_sales: They do NOT require mTLS for week 1; just TLS. They will provide account IDs now: 123456789012 (prod-ish), 210987654321 (poc). CIDRs: 10.20.0.0/16 (TGW), want endpoint subnets in 10.20.10.0/24 and 10.20.11.0/24.

sam_solutions: Great — action plan: 1) I'll create VPCE in us‑west‑2 with interface endpoints in the two subnets. 2) We'll share security group rules and an endpoint policy. 3) A short‑lived API key will be minted and tied to their project. 4) DNS guidance for on‑prem.

sam_solutions: Firewall rules snippet to share with customer (paste into their firewall team):

`Allow outbound TCP 443 to 3.120.45.0/24`  # Replace with the VPCE ENI range we provide
`Allow outbound TCP 443 to vpce-<id>.us-west-2.vpce.amazonaws.com`
`Allow DNS (UDP 53) to their resolver if they will forward to VPC resolver`

sam_solutions: AWS CLI sample to create a VPCE (we'll run this from our infra account, cross‑acct handled via role):

`aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint --vpc-id vpc-0abcd1234 --service-name com.amazonaws.us-west-2.execute-api --vpc-endpoint-type Interface --subnet-ids subnet-0a subnet-0b --security-group-ids sg-0abc1234 --region us-west-2`

sam_solutions: Minimal endpoint policy (restrict to POC API):

`{
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": "*",
      "Action": "execute-api:Invoke",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:execute-api:us-west-2:REDACTED:api-id/*/POST/*"
    }
  ]
}`

raj_infra: DNS note — Private hosted zone vs Route53 resolver: For on‑prem to resolve api.redwood-inference.com to the VPCE address you have two options:
- Route 53 private hosted zone + VPC association + Route53 Resolver inbound endpoint + their on‑prem DNS forwarders -> recommended for production.
- For POC: add a host override on their DNS (or push /etc/hosts) pointing api.poc.redwood-inference.com -> vpce-xxxxx.us-west-2.vpce.amazonaws.com IPs. Simpler but manual.

aisha_se: Security Q: Are logs encrypted and where do they land? Answer: request/response logging uses TLS in transit and we store audit logs in a KMS‑encrypted S3 bucket (we'll provide KMS CMK ARN if they need to grant access).

liz_sales: Pricing question from the buyer — will there be extra per‑GB egress costs for PrivateLink vs normal internet?

sam_solutions: Yes, PrivateLink has per‑GB data processing costs + normal NAT/Transit charges on their side. I'll prepare a one‑page estimate for POC traffic ~100GB.

infra-bot: CREATED TKT-3421: privatelink provisioning for ACME POC — assignee: sam_solutions — due: 2026-04-04

liz_sales: Thanks. Final ask: can we get a short checklist I can paste into the SOW for the customer network team?

sam_solutions: Copyable checklist for SOW / network team:
- Provide AWS account IDs and TGW attachment ID (done).
- Confirm subnet CIDRs for VPCE ENIs (10.20.10.0/24, 10.20.11.0/24).
- Add outbound firewall rule to allow TCP 443 to the VPCE ENI IP ranges (we'll send exact IPs once ENIs exist).
- Decide DNS method: Route53 Resolver inbound for production, hosts override for POC.
- Ensure return path via TGW/DX — if on‑prem uses DNAT, configure SNAT on edge so source IP is routable.
- Whitelist API key ID once issued and rotate after POC.

liz_sales: Perfect. I'll forward to the customer and post any follow ups here. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
